name: zz-verify-uniform-swatches
description: Regression guard for the uniform colour swatches collapsing to a 0px sliver. Chromium's UA stylesheet puts align-items:flex-start on <button>, so .ts-sw-chip (a grid inside the flex-column .ts-sw button) shrink-to-fits its two empty halves unless it has an explicit width. Asserts each chip fills its button and each colour half actually has painted area. Run bob-reset-dave immediately before this so Play routes to team setup.

steps.expression: (function(){var all=document.querySelectorAll('.ts-sw');var unlocked=Array.prototype.filter.call(all,function(b){return !b.classList.contains('is-locked');});return 'total='+all.length+' selectable='+unlocked.length+' selectableName='+(unlocked.length?(unlocked[0].querySelector('.ts-sw-name')||{}).textContent:'NONE')+' (locked ones are dimmed by design via UNLOCKED_COLOR)';})()

(function(){var sw=document.querySelectorAll('.ts-sw');if(sw.length!==8)throw new Error('ASSERT-FAIL expected 8 swatches, got '+sw.length);var bad=[];document.querySelectorAll('.ts-sw-chip').forEach(function(c){var w=c.getBoundingClientRect().width;if(w<=100)bad.push(Math.round(w));});if(bad.length)throw new Error('ASSERT-FAIL '+bad.length+' chip(s) collapsed to border-only slivers: widths=['+bad.join(',')+'] - the UA align-items:flex-start regression is back');return 'ASSERT-OK-8-chips-wide';})()
steps._comment: HARD ASSERT: throws (and fails the step) if any of the 8 chips collapse. 'assert' is not a valid runner action - eval+throw is the working idiom.
